DEPENDABILITY, FROM THE BEGINNING
2016
THE FOUNDATION

One truck.
A reputation earned.

Martinez Logistics LLC began in 2016 with a 26-foot box truck and a mission to provide dependable, professional transportation. Pickups and deliveries for businesses built the foundation: arrive when promised, handle every responsibility carefully, and put the customer first.

Over the years, punctuality, dedication and careful handling became more than operating standards. They became the promise behind the Martinez name.

2025
A NEW EXPRESSION

The same discipline.
A more personal journey.

In 2025, Martinez Logistics expanded into luxury black car and limousine transportation. The operational discipline developed in logistics became the foundation for a chauffeur service serving corporate clients, special events, airport transfers and high-profile travel.

Professional chauffeurs, meticulously maintained vehicles and a commitment to safety, discretion and on-time performance guide this new chapter. The purpose remains familiar: take responsibility for the journey, so the customer can focus on what comes next.

THE PROMISE TODAY

Care you can feel.
Standards you can trust.

01

Professional, from pickup.

Trained chauffeurs bring attention to punctuality, privacy and safe travel. From an executive appointment to a family airport departure, the details of your journey receive personal consideration.

02

Connected to your plans.

Flight monitoring, real-time updates and coordinated meet-and-greet arrangements help bring the handoffs together. Share flight information and pickup requirements when arranging your transfer.

03

Comfort along the way.

Clean, maintained vehicles and climate-controlled comfort create space to settle in. Confirm Wi-Fi, charging, seating and luggage requirements for your selected vehicle when booking.

FROM CURBSIDE TO TAKEOFF

Your journey.
Our responsibility.

From a single truck to a luxury chauffeur service, Martinez Logistics continues to build on the same foundations: reliability, professional care and a customer-first approach.
